versions.changelog: Security and packaging hardening: include declared package.json dependency, include launchd template in bundle, remove user-specific paths, add explicit install metadata, block remote OLLAMA_URL/non-loopback host by default (opt-in flags), and keep package lean.
Add clear install + smoke-test block, tighten quick-start flow, and improve first-run verification steps.

Fix package completeness and portability: include rag-service.mjs + launchd template, remove hardcoded user paths, add dependency metadata, add generic manage.sh workflow, clarify macOS launchd behavior and env-based configuration.
Initial release: always-on local zvec + Ollama semantic search service with launchd + manage.sh workflow.
